Subject: Proposal: Move BlueGrid to Marketplace invoicing (GCP)

Hi Claire / Patrick,

Thanks again for the time last week — really appreciated the product walkthrough and the procurement context. As discussed, we can move BlueGrid from direct invoicing to GCP Marketplace billing which should simplify your internal PO/invoice workflow and allow your finance team to have a single vendor on file. High-level benefits: 

- Single invoice through GCP (no separate Redwood invoices)
- Same list pricing and no hidden markups — we’ll honor the quotes you received from our direct agreement
- Ability to consolidate spend for your internal reporting and use GCP credits/commitments where applicable

I attached a short onboarding guide and our latest pricing spreadsheet for marketplace SKUs. Two quick questions to confirm next steps:
1) Do you want Redwood to be listed as a subscription on the billing account attached to the PO you provided?
2) Who on your side will handle the Marketplace PO/PO number — Patrick or finance@bluegrid.io?

If you’re aligned, we can prepare an order form and send a DocuSign package for signature; marketplace activation typically takes ~3 business days after the signed order.

Attachments: Redwood_GCP_Marketplace_Onboarding_Guide.pdf, Marketplace_PRICING_V2.xlsx

Thanks,

--
Sergio Alvarez

Hi Claire — great questions. Short answers up front: usage visibility and pricing parity are preserved; tax handling follows GCP’s standard flow (GCP will bill and remit sales tax per the billing account settings). A few details: 

- Usage/Reporting: GCP Marketplace provides the same metered usage reports (line-item usage per SKU). We’ll also push a monthly CSV to the shared Drive folder if you want a second copy for your chargeback pipeline.
- Pricing: We will keep the net pricing identical to your current contract (no surprise uplift). Any discounts you have will be mapped to marketplace SKUs in the order form; we’ll include the discount lines in the SOW.
- Tax & Invoicing: Invoice goes to the GCP billing account you designate. If BlueGrid requires the invoice to route to a specific email or PO number we’ll ensure the order form captures that.

Attached: BlueGrid_Marketplace_Order_Form.pdf, BlueGrid_SOW_v1.2.docx

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm billing account and PO owner (Patrick or finance@bluegrid.io).
2) I send the DocuSign order form for Claire/Patrick to sign.
3) Marketplace activation and trial provisioning (3 business days).

Looping Vanessa (ops) and Rishi (partnerships) to own the DocuSign + marketplace activation once you confirm.

Thanks,

--
